label: Challenge record
description: One open challenge as the guard keeps it between calls, through state.port.json: the policy and trigger it gates, the caller it was opened for, the digest of its code and the attempts spent.

id.description: the key: what the caller reads back with the code

method.description: how a code is obtained, one of settings.challenge.methods

trigger.description: the operation the gated trigger fires

subject.description: the caller it was opened for, when one was identified

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601; past it the challenge is void

codeHash.description: the digest of the code issued, never the code itself
